findings.note: The amendment form for the 2020 voter-ID bill adds that if a person's name is not on the precinct list, the election officer shall offer the person the opportunity to register and to vote at the precinct. The bill's record page lists floor amendment (19) as filed 02/24/20 and, on 03/03/20, among those ruled out of order. Filed in her name, so no vote on it was taken.
subjects: registering or voting at the precinct without being on the roll

findings.note: The amendment form for the 2020 voter-ID bill adds the same offer to register and vote at the precinct for a person not on the precinct list, plus related changes to how precinct registration forms are handled and a change to the registration deadline in KRS 116.025.
